note: Fit-audit repaint 2026-10-21 (hook standard v2). Only one feminine word (carafe): she stands left of the wooden pillar with the stairs down and the balcony door; the eight masculine words fill the right. One box per item. S04 v3 (2026-10-21): reviewed for pasted-on figures (none: every figure stands on the floor, sits on a stool or works at the counter); border outpainted and the room pulled back/shifted so the non-smoker kitten and every other item sit at least 6% in from each edge.

items.scene: Same as English 'carafe' (said kah-RAHF): a little girl carefully pours water from a tall glass CARAFE.
Same as English 'barman' (said bahr-MAHN): a young BARMAN with a curly moustache rattles a silver shaker.
GERRY the university DON (gay-ree-DOHN), in a black gown, balances a teacup on a SMALL ROUND TABLE.
Same as English 'soda' (stress at the end, soh-DAH): a fizzy SODA bubbles up and over its glass.
A BEAVER (bew-VUHR) is a big DRINKER, gulping from two glasses at once.
A ROW of APES (ah-pay-ROH) clink little glasses at their evening APÉRO with a bowl of crisps.
A bearded wizard BREWS a bubbling purple POTION in a VASE (bruh-VAHZH).
Same as English 'fast food' (said fahs-TFOOD): a burger and fries on a red tray at a FAST-FOOD counter.
A kitten fans away a puff of FUMES (nohn-few-MUHR) with a paper fan: she is a strict NON-SMOKER.
